services.name: mysql
run: docker rm -f nexus-test-mysql >/dev/null 2>&1; exec docker run --rm --name nexus-test-mysql -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=test -p 127.0.0.1:33070:3306 --tmpfs /var/lib/mysql mysql:8.0 --skip-log-bin

services.name: redis
run: docker rm -f nexus-test-redis >/dev/null 2>&1; exec docker run --rm --name nexus-test-redis -p 127.0.0.1:63790:6379 redis:7-alpine
